title: Your storage
text: One async provider (list, create, rename, move, delete, upload) with an AbortSignal on every call.

title: Built from AbsoluteUI
text: Tree View folders, a Splitter, a Breadcrumb path, menus, dialogs, and progress bars.

title: 10,000 files per folder
text: List and grid views on the shared windowing engine keep about 30 entries in the DOM.

title: Keyboard first
text: Listbox selection, F2, Delete, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V moves, Backspace up, and a context menu.

title: Previews
text: Images open in the Image Viewer, text and code in the Code Viewer, anything else in your preview.
